card_text: Curly top fades for Roswell, adults and kids: dry-air curls, faded sides and one trip for the whole household.

seo.title: Curly Top Fade for Roswell, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Curly top fades for Roswell, cut in Carlsbad south on US 285. Curls in dry air, a fade that grows out slowly, and booking the kids after you.

paragraphs: Your curl pattern does the work on top; I take care of everything below it with a fade. That's the whole idea of a curly top fade, and I cut it in Carlsbad, {{city:roswell.drive_mi}} miles south of Roswell at {{address}}. Count on about {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes on {{city:roswell.route}} each way, through Artesia (OpenStreetMap routing).
Below: what dry air does to curls, how to pick a fade that survives the gap between trips, and how a family books it.

blocks.heading: Less frizz, more thirst.
paragraphs: Roswell's air averages around {{city:roswell.humidity_pct}} humidity (Open-Meteo, 2023–25). For curly hair that cuts both ways: damp-climate frizz mostly isn't your problem, but dry curls lose their spring and look dull faster. When I shape the top I cut for how your curl behaves dry, not wet, and I'll tell you how much length your pattern needs to keep its bounce.

blocks.eyebrow: 02 / A FADE THAT WAITS FOR YOU
blocks.heading: Curls forgive. Skin doesn't.
paragraphs: Growth on top just reads as more curl. Growth on faded sides is what gives the cut away, and from Roswell every touch-up is another {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes behind the wheel. If you can't come back often, say so: a low or mid fade keeps more hair on the sides and softens as it grows, where a skin-tight version looks due much sooner.

blocks.heading: Adults and kids book the same way.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: Curls shaped on top, the fade at whatever height we agree on, and a straight razor neckline. This is the booking for a kid's curly top too.

items.title: Kids' haircuts
items.body: {{city:roswell.under18_pct}} of Roswell is under 18 (Census ACS 2023). If that's your house, book each child their own slot right after yours so one drive covers everyone.

blocks.heading: Curly questions from up the road.

items.q: Should I wash my curls before the drive down from Roswell?
items.a: Come with your hair the way you normally wear it, dry. I want to see the real curl before I cut, and {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes in the car is enough for it to settle.

items.q: Can a kid from Roswell get a curly top fade?
items.a: Yes. Kids are welcome, and parents choose the Essential Haircut for them on Booksy. If a child is nervous about clippers, a low fade is a gentle place to start.

items.q: Which fade height holds up longest between visits?
items.a: Low, then mid, then skin. The less bare scalp I expose, the slower the grow-out shows. The curly top fade page shows the skin version so you can compare.
